title: BBC Sci-Fi Radio Plays
paragraphs: A library collection of BBC science-fiction dramatizations, ranging from classic literary adaptations to original radio plays. It is a compilation rather than one continuous BBC series.

Curated audio-drama compilation rather than one continuous historical BBC series. The 43 frozen objects mix standalone radio plays, serialized parts, compiled serials and a 14-track 2016 Audible drama. Chronology, broadcaster and creative credits are therefore item-specific.

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Dirk Maggs (radio adaptor on 14 recordings and director on 14 recordings), Tim Lebbon (author on 14 recordings), Michael Patrick (writer on 5 recordings), Michael Shannon (producer on 5 recordings), Oisín Kearney (writer on 5 recordings), Simon Barnard (director on 4 recordings and producer on 4 recordings), and Daphne du Maurier (author on 3 recordings).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include science-fiction and speculative audio-drama collection, extraterrestrial life and alien threat, time distortion and altered reality, dystopia and social control, paranormal or uncanny phenomena, and espionage and secret-agent adventure.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including BBC tradition of literary science-fiction adaptation, Radio drama into podcast and digital-audio distribution, and Mixed-provenance digital archive.
